from.place: the statement's assertion that Mod(O) is Grothendieck abelian on a small ringed site

title: Sheaves of modules on a small ringed site are Grothendieck abelian
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site whose underlying category is small and let $\mathcal O$ be a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$. The abelian category $\Mod(\mathcal O)$ of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] is Grothendieck abelian [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian]: it has all small colimits, filtered colimits are exact, and the family of free sheaves $j_{U!}\mathcal O_U$ indexed by objects $U$ of $\mathcal C$ yields a generator $\bigoplus_{U\in\operatorname{Ob}\mathcal C}j_{U!}\mathcal O_U$, where $\mathcal O_U$ is the restriction of $\mathcal O$ to the localized site $\mathcal C/U$ [def-pur-localized-ringed-site] and $j_{U!}\mathcal O_U$ is the sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] of the extension-by-zero presheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules $P_{\mathcal O_U}$ [def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf].
